title: Verify which error a delete-pending Git metadata entry yields on Windows, so the identity walk's vanished-entry skip covers it
outcome: identity_gone (src/review_identity.rs) treats NotFound and Windows ERROR_DELETE_PENDING (303) as a vanished entry in the Git metadata walk. A file deleted while another handle holds it open may instead surface from symlink_metadata or read_dir as ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED (5). If so, the walk still fails such an entry as input_unavailable, and docs/features/review-identity.md overstates what is handled. A held-open-handle test on Windows should establish the real code; then either identity_gone covers it (restricted to the delete-pending case, not every access denial) or the doc names only the codes actually handled.
acceptance: A Windows test holds a handle open on a Git metadata entry, deletes it, and records which error symlink_metadata and read_dir yield. The identity walk skips that delete-pending entry without treating genuine access denials as vanished, or the doc is narrowed to the handled codes.
